name: Deshi Shahi Cow
description: Healthy deshi cow suitable for Qurbani. Raised on natural grass and straw, calm nature and fully vaccinated.

description: Strong and calm Sahiwal bull with a heavy build and good meat yield. Well fed and regularly checked by a vet.

description: Large Brahman cross bull with a strong frame. Ideal for big family or shared Qurbani.

description: Compact Barbari goat with a shiny coat and good body weight. Calm and easy to handle.

name: Garole Sheep
description: Healthy Garole sheep with soft tender meat. Raised on natural grass and suitable for Qurbani.
